candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0), causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool size 5 with 0 idle at failure, but no pool wait-time or saturation time series was admitted to confirm exhaustion versus slow postgres.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with order ReadTimeout; order traces show postgres save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, and order metrics show 503s on /v1/orders. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; pool saturation time series still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool wait/acquire latency and active-connection time series for order service
Postgres server-side health/latency metrics to rule out slow database rather than pool exhaustion
